title: Orphan Port — Po24 on dc1-leaf1a Only
symptom: Server srv-db-04 on Po24 unreachable. Po24 active on dc1-leaf1a but absent from DC1_L3_LEAF1 MLAG table on dc1-leaf1b. Peer-link up.
root_cause: Port-Channel24 with mlag 24 created only on dc1-leaf1a. No corresponding MLAG interface on dc1-leaf1b. Traffic via dc1-leaf1b has no path to the host.
fix_command:
interface Port-Channel24
no mlag 24
no description
exit
no interface Port-Channel24
